name: freeze-and-is-frozen-test-c0f3b0e88b/frozen-any-array-update-p.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.value lists cloneWithType, fromJsonWithType, toString and toBalString.

Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:"; the value entries are value:cloneWithType, value:fromJsonWithType, value:toString and value:toBalString.
reason: The expected panic on updating i2[1] depends on i1.cloneReadOnly() producing a frozen array. cloneReadOnly is absent from both the permitted lang.value functions and the permitted langlib method-call list, so an essential operation is outside subset 10.
test_design_notes: The @panic annotation asserts mutation rejection of the cloned array; supporting ordinary array assignments alone does not cover that behavior.
